text:
why do you guys draw?

I think for me the "why" is about expressing myself

sounds vague... maybe the idea that a part of my soul gets to touch the page and permanently transform it into something unique

something that lives on after life claims my body

maybe that sounds silly in combination with cute anime girls, but I personally feel comfort and awe when I look at stylized faces and colorful lines and textures and I want to make other people feel those same positive feelings with the things I've created

something ai can't ever replicate btw, because it requires a human (or at least living) soul

it's hard to stay motivated when perfectionism tells you it will never be good enough

that's why I post my old art here, because I made a lot of those drawings without thinking about whether it will be good

I just wanted to create something

and that's very special to me
